sanskrit_verse:
पृथिवी पादतस्तस्य शिरसो द्यौरजायत |
नस्तः प्राणा दिशः श्रोत्रात् स्पर्शाद् वायुर्मुखाच्छिखी ||
transliteration: pṛthivī pādatastasya śiraso dyaur ajāyata | nastaḥ prāṇā diśaḥ śrotrāt sparśād vāyur mukhāc chikhī ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From the feet of the Supreme Being arose the Earth; from the head, the sky. From the nose came breath and the quarters of space. From the ears came the directions and from touch, fire and wind issued forth from the mouth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the embodied totality of cosmic consciousness
Causation flows hierarchically through divine limbs to manifest universal order
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with the organ through which dharma manifests
Restoration logic requires alignment with the originating limb of consciousness
Consciousness alignment reflects the sequential emanation of cosmic functions
executable_legal_axioms: IF an act pertains to territorial governance THEN jurisdiction derives from the foundational limb (feet) representing stability and grounding
IF a ruling involves celestial or temporal sovereignty THEN it must invoke the head-limb authority denoting vision and command
IF regulation concerns respiration or life-force THEN it originates from the nasal limb denoting sustenance and vitality
IF directional or spatial integrity is at issue THEN hearing-based discernment (ears) determines lawful orientation
IF sensory causality governs conduct THEN tactile awareness (skin) serves as primary pramāṇa for adjudication
supreme_court_application: In matters involving national territory, constitutional authority stems from the stabilizing force represented by the feet of Paramashivam. Sovereign decisions require invocation of the head-limb wisdom. Spatial disputes invoke directional discernment via the ear-limb faculty. Life-support rulings emanate from the nose-limb domain. Sensory justice relies upon tactile pramāṇa when physical interaction determines outcome.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality traces actions to their originating sensory or spatial limbs without assigning blame. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that each limb's emanation follows in sequence, establishing proportional responsibility tied to functional origin rather than fault. Non-punitive reality rule prevails because all limbs serve the unified body of dharma; correction restores alignment, not inflicts pain.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate limb-specific completion process wherein misaligned action retraces its causal path back to source consciousness
Engage responsibility assumption protocol where actor identifies their sensory-emergent root and realigns accordingly
Execute capacity restoration by reconnecting individual function with corresponding cosmic limb
Undertake integrity reintegration through ritual acknowledgment of limb-origin and reaffirmation of dharma-service
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Cosmic order is restored through recognition of limb-derived function. There is no punishment—only realignment of consciousness with its emanated capacities. Reality itself adjudicates through the sequential unfolding of divine embodiment.
